name: beam-5f
kind: oscillator family of period 4: a rake gun, N units of rake train, a rake absorber
found: left = mirror image ((x,y,z) -> (z-4,y,x+4)) of the gun of objects/gun-5f.json with its train; right = python3 sat_gun.py fb 31 --dir 1 (1 s), a state of period 4 inside the planes x+y-z, x-y-z <= 31 of the 3 x 3 tube into which the rake train (fb)^inf runs; joined where the two trains agree
note: Object(N) = left + b0 moved by k*(2,0,-2) for even k, b1 for odd k (k = 0..N-1) + R_even or R_odd (by the parity of N) moved by N*(2,0,-2). The cells are given at an ODD generation of wire C; one generation later the train reads bfbf... (family units: b = wire C, f = wire C + the rake cell (1,0,4)). Rakes leave the left end every 4 generations, move towards +v one unit per 2 generations and are swallowed by the right end; the object has period exactly 4 for every N >= 1 tried. Removing the rake cell of one rake (one generation after the stored phase) makes a hole: from then on the state differs from the undisturbed object in exactly ONE cell at every second generation (hole_cell of the unit, i.e. a B unit where a rake should be), the hole moves with the rakes and the right end swallows it: afterwards the object is exactly as if nothing had happened.
